selection: All 19 scenarios require one most and one different least in A–E.

formulas.most: M[c] = sum over 19 scenarios of indicator(most selection category == c)
formulas.least: L[c] = sum over 19 scenarios of indicator(least selection category == c)
formulas.dominant: all categories tied for max M[c]; report all ties
formulas.least_preferred: all categories tied for max L[c]
formulas.domain: same most-selection category count restricted to source-defined domain; report all max ties
formulas.normalization: none; no reverse scoring, difference score, total ability score, percentile or diagnostic threshold

domains.zh_Hans: 与教师及工作人员的互动

runtime_gate.required: Exactly 19 complete pairs; both selections in A-E; most != least enforced by authoritative submission/scoring layer, plus immediate UI validation. Reject invalid or duplicate scenario IDs, missing pairs and same-option pairs.
runtime_gate.ties: Report every category tied for maximum independently for most and least. Domain summaries use most only.
runtime_gate.prohibited: No most-minus-least score, total ability score, diagnostic threshold, percentile, benchmark or right-answer key.

review_scope: GO_FOR_DRAFT_CONTENT only. Not psychometric validation, runtime approval, or deployment authorization.
